entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider offering a universal memory layer for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available via managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted OSS.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication to sustain sub-300ms recall. It provides memory, RAG, and user profiles through a single API with connectors for services like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that uses the viking:// protocol and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token spend. It provides observable retrieval trajectories for debugging and has demonstrated token reduction and task-completion gains on LoCoMo10.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for OpenClaw and Hermes Agents that creates a self-wiring knowledge graph using typed edges. It supports local deployment via PGLite and provides synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A learning-based agent memory system focused on long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is deployable via Docker and provides client SDKs for Python and Node.js.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like versioning, including commit, branch, and merge operations. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that operates using a single SQLite database for sub-millisecond performance. It includes temporal knowledge graph capabilities, episodic compression, and MCP support.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness designed to help agents solve complex tasks. It provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets, along with CLI tools for simulating and investigating tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin for Hermes Agent that employs a DAG-based engine to ensure no messages are lost. It uses a SQLite message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting local inference servers or OpenAI-compatible providers.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems utilizing an open YAML format for engrams. It provides local-first, zero-cost search and supports MCP tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer provides portable identity, memory, and secrets for agents including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features tools to inspect, edit, and repair memory alongside a dedicated dashboard for retrieval inspection.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and vector search without cloud dependencies. It integrates through MCP and Claude Code hooks, using a local GGUF observer model to capture decisions.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency and token usage through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is distributed as a five-package plugin family including an SDK, CLI, and Hermes adapter.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a why_retrieved tag to every recall. It tracks contradictions through conflict and resolution primitives and supports both embedded and HTTP backend modes.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp to provide local-first storage.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets to the agent.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory solution that utilizes semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It automates indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia while using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to minimize prompt tokens before the context window opens. It supports tool-based workspace interaction via the Model Context Protocol and offers encrypted persistent memory through the Perseus Vault.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A daemonless memory system that stores information as inspectable Markdown files to ensure user ownership. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single.lbdb embedded graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features an importance ranking system to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory for Hermes Agent that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session AI memory through semantic search and session snapshots. It mirrors native Hermes memory writes to XMemo to facilitate cross-agent recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server allows APIs to charge for themselves using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to enable AI agent payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage, searching, and configurable query expansion and reranking.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This reusable plugin provides five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on local artifacts. It supports indexing for skills, scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic and literal code search. It runs locally over localhost and supports grounded Q&A with file-and-line citations.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native long-term memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It also includes MinHash for near-duplicate detection.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides an agentic skills methodology for software development, including capabilities for testing, debugging, and collaboration. It supports various harnesses like Claude Code and Cursor through a subagent-driven-development process.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4. It features automation, design systems, and plugin capabilities compatible with local CLI executables and coding agents.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library contains 817 production-grade skills across 29 security domains, mapped to six major frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It is compatible with 26+ AI platforms and Hermes Agent.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities to generate diagrams from natural language descriptions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to remove detectable AI writing patterns using 57 pattern categories. It supports Rewrite, Detect, and Edit modes and is compatible with Hermes and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication, quality improvement, and unified skill libraries across multiple devices and agents.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents. It includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals via natural-language mandates and escrow. It includes a master router, connector skills, and vendored official protocol skills.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation, offering slash commands to manage and save patterns.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This collection provides skills for video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other agents. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI through modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This skill set teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts by generating custom thinking instructions. It includes pre-built analytical lenses and reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running AI agents through a three-level work model. It provides structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by weaving code and documentation into.lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs source edits back to the document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the Agent Skills specification to support CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration. They include specialized skills for CRE and ACE services.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, error handling, and JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files by converting repositories, documentation, or developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides provenance through documentation URLs or file:line citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and includes commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running tasks with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. It includes built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This client uses a three-layer progressive loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This workflow language uses a single Rust binary to enable local-first execution for any model. It provides static auditing for costs, secrets, types, and permissions, and generates hash-chained, verifiable receipts.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill manages files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a 5-layer intelligent skill retrieval system using hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation if dependencies are missing.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model family and reasoning capability while tracking quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This tool performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It utilizes a deterministic pre-scan layer with Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec, and includes an MCP server to generate suppression rules.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io features MCP integration and tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure using SKILL.md files.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures to implement multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This multi-agent skill uses a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It employs a risk-tiered triage system for code modifications and includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub facilitates community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation via the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously 24/7 on NVIDIA infrastructure and integrates federated search with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and agentskills.io standards.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street level. It produces structured reports with core conclusions and action suggestions, using semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This repository provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are automatically updated on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This project offers scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install Windows desktop agent that requires no admin rights or Docker. It features a GUI, an integrated workflow engine for multi-step pipelines, and an extensive toolset including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository provides an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama as well as major providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports configurable gateway mode.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project sandboxes Hermes Agent using hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state via mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and identities. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers or local Ollama models to power fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It employs structured-output agents to facilitate financial trading decision making.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: An orchestration platform that supports workflows across CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and other agents. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API to monitor spend, track tasks, and manage scheduling.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: A control surface providing TUI, web, and CLI interfaces for managing various coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A template featuring a tiered architecture and task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single agents to automated teams. It provides bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A tool for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: A mission control interface that uses a Kanban board and review queues to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents for research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: A meta-optimization harness designed to automate the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena where nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies compete for GitHub stars. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and features a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: An ACP-style delegation system that routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via timeouts and output character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This Rust-powered kernel provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph designed to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux and features automatic project synchronization.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage across multiple AI clients and coding agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It features a native Rust TUI and a visualization dashboard for monitoring local agent session data.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This tool acts as a local trace viewer for inspecting API traffic from agents like Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Cursor. It allows users to export local trace sessions to HTML and redacts common auth headers during recording.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and Claude.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows that support autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This community CLI tool allows for the customization of Hermes terminal UI elements like banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. It uses YAML-based configuration to enable the creation of diverse themes, such as cyberpunk or retro DOS aesthetics.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively within CCC without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and GGUF inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It provides a visible UI for real-time AI supervision and includes integrated session management and a research desk.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings through specialized CLI workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance on macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configurations and skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories and tools.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: This static linter validates AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using regex and structural heuristics. It supports JSON, YAML, plain text, Markdown, and.prompt files without requiring model or API calls, and includes HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool facilitates the transition from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by transferring SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives. It maps OpenClaw configs and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides self-healing capabilities for multi-agent systems through automated operational and functional health monitoring. It includes a beta Hermes plugin that exports telemetry for API requests and tool calls, alongside token intelligence tracking for cost estimation and memory bloat.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with the Tauri 2 framework that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a centralized interface for managing Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application designed for various agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features built-in assistants for PPT, Word, and Excel, and supports remote access via WebUI and several messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface built with Python and vanilla JavaScript that provides full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. The layout features three panels, including chat and a workspace file browser, optimized for use on web browsers or mobile phones.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed to assist with the installation and configuration of Hermes Agent and its providers. It provides a graphical user interface for managing chats, sessions, and tools.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard that offers multi-platform AI chat, session management, and scheduled jobs. It includes a file browser, web terminal, usage analytics, and unified configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace that integrates a chat interface with a terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that facilitates direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes embedded terminal access for system repair and native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, Rust, and TypeScript. It supports both Windows and macOS and includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects the active browser context to a local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtime. It includes Hermes Web for full-page workspace sessions.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application that serves as a session browser, agent cockpit, and analytics tracker for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It operates locally with no telemetry and provides live per-session quota burn-rate tracking.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts or Orgo cloud computers. It features one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: This OpenTUI-based terminal dashboard consolidates Hermes Agent chat, sessions, and configuration into a single interface. It includes integrated kanban boards for task and diagnostic management alongside an extensible Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. The interface supports terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachments, while allowing for five concurrent background agent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This no-install Windows desktop application provides a GUI and workflow engine for scheduled, multi-step automation pipelines. It functions without admin rights or Docker and includes 100 tools, such as ComfyUI and TTS extensions.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface designed for self-hosted AI assistance. It features real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard provides real-time monitoring of session activity and cost tracking. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories, skill source code, and read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes a marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client enables orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and supports model switching via streaming SSE responses.
